rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N serves as a mandatory one-to-one join key to Cust_Bio_dirty and must be populated for referential integrity

rule: S_N must be unique across the table
rationale: Evidence identifies this as a one-to-one shared key, yet one duplicate value (3) was detected requiring validation

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account number is a mandatory business identifier with 0% missing values in the sample

rule: Account_No must be exactly 4 digits when represented as string
rationale: Evidence indicates account numbers are uniformly 4 characters long (range 1001-1028) and intended to be stored as string

rule: Full_Name must not be null
rationale: Full name is a mandatory demographic field with 0% missing values

rule: Full_Name words (excluding cultural particles) must follow title case convention
rationale: Evidence shows deterministic case deviations: 'junrong', 'irfan', 'Hui Min tan', 'Lee yixuan' violate the dominant title-case convention

check_params.logic: pd.notna(row['Full_Name']) and any((w[0].islower() or w.isupper()) for w in str(row['Full_Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: Full_Name must not contain consecutive whitespace characters
rationale: Evidence identifies extra whitespace in 'Ramesh s/o  Govindasamy' requiring standardization

rule: ID must not be null
rationale: ID is a mandatory unique identifier (NRIC/FIN format) with 0% missing values

rule: ID must match Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S, T, F, or G), followed by 7 digits, ending with one uppercase letter
rationale: 96.7% of values follow the 9-character format aXXXXXXXa; one value 'S123456' appears truncated and violates this format

rule: JoinDate must not be null
rationale: Join date is a mandatory historical timestamp with 3.3% observed missing values requiring validation

rule: JoinDate must be a parseable datetime value
rationale: Evidence shows one unparseable value '2025-13-01' (invalid month 13) and the column is intended as datetime64[ns]

rule: JoinDate must not be in the future
rationale: JoinDate is a historical field (account creation); evidence shows future date '2027-01-15' which violates business logic

rule: LastLogin must not be null
rationale: Last login is a mandatory activity tracking field with 0% missing values

rule: LastLogin must be a parseable datetime value
rationale: Column is stored as string but intended as datetime64[ns]; all sample values appear parseable but validation is required

rule: JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin
rationale: Business logic requires account creation date to precede or equal the last login date; sample shows violations where LastLogin predates JoinDate

rule: Subscription_Type must not be null
rationale: Subscription tier is a mandatory categorical field with 0% missing values

rule: Subscription_Type must be one of the valid subscription tiers
rationale: Evidence shows 5 distinct valid values: Basic, Free, Gold, Platinum, Premium

rule: SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a numeric value when not null
rationale: Column is stored as string with intended type float64; evidence shows non-numeric value 'free' that cannot be parsed

rule: SubscriptionFee must not contain sentinel placeholder values
rationale: Evidence identifies '99999' as a statistical outlier and likely sentinel value representing missing/unknown data

rule: SubscriptionFee must be non-negative
rationale: Subscription fees represent monetary amounts that should not be negative

rule: When Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be 0 or null
rationale: Business logic requires free subscriptions to have no associated fee; evidence shows non-zero fees for Free subscriptions

check_params.logic: row['Subscription_Type'] == 'Free' and pd.notna(row['SubscriptionFee']) and pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce') != 0

rule: Status must not be null
rationale: Status is a mandatory boolean indicator with 0% missing values

rule: Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
rationale: Evidence shows inconsistent boolean representations (True, False, 1, 0, yes, no) that must be validated before standardization

rule: AccountBalance must not be null
rationale: Account balance is a mandatory financial field with 0% missing values

rule: AccountBalance must not contain sentinel placeholder values
rationale: Evidence identifies 99999.0 as a statistical outlier and likely sentinel-coded missing value

rule: AccountBalance negative values require review
rationale: Evidence flags -150.5 as sign-anomalous; negative balances may represent overdrafts or data errors requiring validation

rule: PreferredLanguage must not be null
rationale: Preferred language is a mandatory categorical field with 0% missing values

rule: PreferredLanguage must be a valid language option
rationale: Evidence shows 5 distinct valid values: English, French, German, Malay, Tamil

rule: Device must not be null
rationale: Device type is a mandatory categorical field with 0% missing values

rule: Device must be a valid device type
rationale: Evidence shows 3 distinct valid values: Desktop, Mobile, Tablet

rule: OS must not be null
rationale: Operating system is a mandatory categorical field with 0% missing values

rule: OS must be a valid operating system with canonical casing
rationale: Evidence shows casing inconsistencies (android, IOS, LINUX, macOs) that must be standardized to canonical forms: Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, macOS

rule: FeedbackScore must not be null
rationale: Feedback score is a mandatory numeric field with 0% missing values

rule: FeedbackScore must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Evidence shows 81.25% resemblance to FeedbackScore1 (range 1.0-5.0) and value 7.3 is flagged as a statistical outlier/sentinel, indicating valid range is 1-5

rule: FeedbackScore1 must not be null
rationale: Feedback score is a mandatory numeric field with 0% missing values

rule: FeedbackScore1 must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Observed values range from 1.0 to 5.0, consistent with a standard 5-point rating scale

rule: S_N must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N
rationale: S_N is identified as a one-to-one shared key with Cust_Bio_dirty; referential integrity requires all values to exist in the parent table

rule: ID must match the corresponding ID_No in Cust_Bio_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: ID and ID_No represent the same national identifier concept across tables and must be consistent for matching S_N values

check_params.semantic_check: ID must exactly match ID_No for records with the same S_N

rule: Full_Name cultural particles must be consistent with Gender in Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Malay/Indian naming particles encode gender: Bin/s/o indicate Male, Binte/d/o indicate Female; these must match the Gender column in the sibling table

check_params.semantic_check: If Full_Name contains 'Bin' or 's/o', Gender must be Male; if 'Binte' or 'd/o', Gender must be Female (case-insensitive)
